The plate is roughly 340 px wide in the image. If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that gives about 0.076 cm per px, or 13 px per cm.

The two corn pieces are each about 95 px across, which is about 7 cm. Each is a cob segment standing on end, with a height of about 3 cm. A cylinder with a 3.5 cm radius and 3 cm height has a volume of about 115 cm³. The cob is part core and the density is lower, so each piece is about 90 g. Two pieces come to about 180 g.

There is also one loose kernel on the plate, which weighs about 0.3 g.

Corn on the cob is about 90 kcal per 100 g, counting the cob weight.
